metadata.question: In November 2021, did Seattle experience less than 20cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS Daily precipitation dataset (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) is ideal for rainfall (unit: mm). - Date: Filter to November 2021 (2021-11-01 to 2021-11-30). - Location: A Point over Seattle, WA (approx. -122.33, 47.61). 2. Masking strategy: CHIRPS is a precipitation product; no cloud mask is needed. 3. Logic: - Sum total November rainfall in mm. - Convert to cm and compare with 20 cm (200 mm). - Use .reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.sum(), …, scale=5000) to avoid timeout. - Ensure collection.size().getInfo() > 0 → else C1. - Check pixel count after reduce: if 0 → C2. - Result must be a finite number; else C3. - Print concise stats. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.33, 47.61]) nov2021 = ee.DateRange('2021-11-01', '2021-12-01') # exclusive end # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterBounds(seattle).filterDate(nov2021) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No CHIRPS images for Nov 2021.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Processing: sum rainfall over November total = col.sum().select('precipitation') count = total.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=seattle, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") exit() # 4. Calculation: total rainfall in mm, convert to cm sum_mm = total.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=seattle, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() if sum_mm is None or not isinstance(sum_mm, (int, float)): print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") exit() sum_cm = sum_mm / 10.0 print(f"Nov 2021 rainfall: {sum_cm:.1f} cm, Pixels: {int(count)}") # 5. Answer print("A" if sum_cm < 20 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.33, 47.61])
nov2021 = ee.DateRange('2021-11-01', '2021-12-01')  # exclusive end

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
        .filterBounds(seattle).filterDate(nov2021)
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No CHIRPS images for Nov 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing: sum rainfall over November
total = col.sum().select('precipitation')
count = total.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=seattle,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('precipitation').getInfo()

if count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculation: total rainfall in mm, convert to cm
sum_mm = total.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=seattle,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('precipitation').getInfo()

if sum_mm is None or not isinstance(sum_mm, (int, float)):
    print("Calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

sum_cm = sum_mm / 10.0
print(f"Nov 2021 rainfall: {sum_cm:.1f} cm, Pixels: {int(count)}")

# 5. Answer
print("<answer>A</answer>" if sum_cm < 20 else "<answer>B</answer>")
